exposure: Mode of labour onset (induced vs. spontaneous)
cohort: 18,396 women with term singleton pregnancies in cephalic presentation aiming for vaginal delivery in Helsinki, Finland
finding: Poor childbirth experience was associated with labor induction, primiparity, operative delivery, and labor complications, such as post-partum hemorrhage and maternal infections.
mod_finding: The women who underwent labor induction were less satisfied with their birth experience compared to women with spontaneous onset of labor.
